requirements.title: ISHFT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer, SHIFT shall be integer, and ABS(SHIFT) shall not exceed BIT_SIZE(I).

pending.ISHFT-I-integer: Positive control calls ISHFT with an integer I containing distinguished low and high bits; source-control mutation changes I to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.ISHFT-SHIFT-integer: Positive control calls ISHFT with integer SHIFT values -1, 0, and 1; source-control mutation changes SHIFT to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.ISHFT-SHIFT-absolute-value-not-greater-t: Positive control calls ISHFT with SHIFT values -BIT_SIZE(I), 0, and BIT_SIZE(I); source-control mutations use magnitudes beyond BIT_SIZE(I) and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: ISHFT result characteristics match I
requirements.definition: The ISHFT result has the same integer type and kind as I.

pending.ISHFT-result-same-integer-kind-as-I: Call ISHFT with default integer I and with selected_int_kind(18) I; 7.4.3.1 p2 requires at least one integer representation method with decimal exponent range >= 18, so selected_int_kind(18) is a valid kind. Assert KIND(ISHFT(I,1)) equals KIND(I) for each call and mutate the I kind used in the expected expression.

requirements.title: ISHFT logical bit shift result value
requirements.definition: The ISHFT result is formed by shifting the bit sequence of I by SHIFT positions, left for positive SHIFT, right for negative SHIFT, unchanged for zero SHIFT, losing shifted-out bits and shifting zeros in from the opposite end.

pending.ISHFT-positive-left-shift-bits: Use I with only bits 0 and 2 set and SHIFT=3; observe by BTEST that only bits 3 and 5 among the checked positions are set, and mutate SHIFT sign to move the bits right.
pending.ISHFT-negative-right-shift-bits: Use I with only bits 4 and 6 set and SHIFT=-2; observe by BTEST that only bits 2 and 4 among the checked positions are set, and mutate SHIFT sign to move the bits left.
pending.ISHFT-zero-shift-preserves-bits: Use I with bits 0, 3, and BIT_SIZE(I)-2 set and SHIFT=0; compare selected BTEST results with I and mutate SHIFT to 1 to change the observed pattern.
pending.ISHFT-shifted-out-bits-lost-and-zeros-sh: Use I with bit BIT_SIZE(I)-1 set for left shift by 1 and bit 0 set for right shift by 1; observe by BTEST that the vacated opposite-end bit is clear and the shifted-out bit is not reintroduced.
